'''Kylaena''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], she became one of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild's]] top ten most-wanted fugitives, for the assassination of [[Ead Vionor]], a major shareholder in [[Bunkurd Corporation]]. She was also suspected of committing fourteen other assassinations in the six [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to that. An unknown [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] tracked her down and killed her.

==Behind the scenes==
Kylaena was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Kylaena was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Dangerous Fugitives|"Dangerous Fugitives" collection]],<ref name="SWG:DF" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 3|Game Update 3]]" on [[April 29]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 3">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67727&month=042008|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 3}}</ref>

Kylaena was the nickname of ''Star Wars Galaxies'' designer [[Janessa Johansson]].<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swggpdiscussion&message.id=994272|text=Meet the SWG Devs and Team: Come Say Hi!}}</ref>
